user.title: Layercast
user.description: Pick the weather entity to base clothing recommendations on. It must provide an hourly forecast. Default periods and rules are created and can be changed afterwards.

error.no_hourly_forecast: This weather entity does not provide an hourly forecast.

abort.already_configured: This weather entity is already configured.

user.title: Add period
user.description: A time window of the day. If it already ended today, the same period tomorrow is used. If the end is before the start, it runs past midnight.

user.title: Add rule
user.description: A garment or item and where it is shown. In the next step you set the weather it is recommended for.

data_description.image_url: Shown as a badge instead of the bundled icon. Items that a figure does not draw are shown this way.
data_description.group: Within a group only the matching rule with the highest priority is shown, for example one jacket out of several.
data_description.priority: Higher wins within a group. On a tie the rule listed first wins.
data_description.image: Drawn on the figure if the figure has this item, otherwise shown as a small badge below it.

reconfigure.title: Change rule
reconfigure.description: A garment or item and where it is shown. In the next step you set the weather it is recommended for.

data_description.image_url: Shown as a badge instead of the bundled icon. Items that a figure does not draw are shown this way.
data_description.group: Within a group only the matching rule with the highest priority is shown, for example one jacket out of several.
data_description.priority: Higher wins within a group. On a tie the rule listed first wins.
data_description.image: Drawn on the figure if the figure has this item, otherwise shown as a small badge below it.

conditions.title: Weather conditions
conditions.description: Leave a field empty to ignore it. All filled fields must match. A rule that needs data the weather entity does not provide is never shown and is listed as unsupported on the sensor.

data_description.temp_below: Matches if it gets this cold at any time in the period.
data_description.temp_above: Matches if it gets this warm at any time in the period.
data_description.temp_min_above: Matches only if even the coldest hour of the period is this warm.
data_description.feels_below: Like temperature, but includes wind chill. Calculated if the weather entity does not provide a feels-like forecast.
data_description.feels_above: Like temperature, but includes the heat index. Calculated if the weather entity does not provide a feels-like forecast.
data_description.uv: Highest in the period. Hours with the sun low in the sky count as 0, because some sources repeat the daily maximum for every hour.

weather_unavailable.message: The weather entity {entity} is not available.

forecast_failed.message: Could not get the hourly forecast of {entity}: {error}
